# Poki

> > Poki is a free online gaming platform offering hundreds of browser-based games across multiple genres with no downloads required.

Poki provides instant access to casual and competitive games including popular titles like Subway Surfers, Retro Bowl, and Stickman Hook. The platform specializes in browser-based gaming with support for multiplayer, single-player, and co-op experiences across all skill levels.

## Key Topics

- Browser games
- Free-to-play
- Multiplayer gaming
- Casual games
- IO games
- Shooting games
- Co-op games
- Mobile games
- Online gaming
- Game collections
- Subway Surfers
- Retro Bowl
- Stickman Hook
- No downloads required
- Competitive play

## Featured Games

- [Subway Surfers](https://poki.com/en/g/subway-surfers): Endless runner escaping security with power-ups and coins.
- [Stickman Battle](https://poki.com/en/g/stickman-battle): Physics-based fighting game with weapons and stick figure combat.
- [Mr Racer - Car Racing](https://poki.com/en/g/mr-racer-car-racing): 3D racing game with customizable cars and highway traffic challenges.
- [Combat Online 2](https://poki.com/en/g/combat-online-2): Multiplayer FPS with weapon customization and team gameplay.

## Game Categories

- [Multiplayer Games](https://poki.com/en/multiplayer): Compete and cooperate in real-time browser worlds.
- [Shooting Games](https://poki.com/en/shooting): FPS, multiplayer battles, and zombie games on Poki.
- [Action Games](https://poki.com/en/action): Platformers, fighting, shooting games for reflexes.
- [IO Games](https://poki.com/en/io): Fast-paced multiplayer arenas for battle and survival.
- [Two-Player Games](https://poki.com/en/two-player): 130+ free browser games for competitive and co-op play.
- [Car Games](https://poki.com/en/car): Racing, drifting, parking challenges with no downloads.
- [Adventure Games](https://poki.com/en/adventure): Explore worlds, solve puzzles, and embark on quests online.

## Puzzle & Brain Games

- [Puzzle Games](https://poki.com/en/puzzle): Brain-teasers, logic problems, word games, and match-3 challenges.
- [Brain Games](https://poki.com/en/brain): Memory, logic, and problem-solving puzzles to sharpen your mind.
- [Skill Games](https://poki.com/en/skill): Test reflexes and precision in races, puzzles, and challenges.
- [Math Games](https://poki.com/en/math): Arithmetic, fractions, geometry, and number puzzles for learning.

## Themed & Creative Games

- [Minecraft Games](https://poki.com/en/minecraft): Build, survive, and explore creative worlds online.
- [Roblox Games](https://poki.com/en/roblox): User-created worlds, obbys, and adventures on Poki.
- [Dress Up Games](https://poki.com/en/dress-up): Fashion, makeovers, avatars, and styling games online.

## Sports & Lifestyle Games

- [Sports Games](https://poki.com/en/sports): Athletic competitions, tournaments, and skill-based challenges.
